skill.summary: Audit any website across 8 quality signals to determine if it is outdated, broken, or neglected. Returns a structured audit dict used by the lead-scorer skill.

latestVersion.changelog: Audits websites across all 8 quality signals: HTTP status, copyright year, Last-Modified header, Wappalyzer tech stack, Google PageSpeed score, mobile responsiveness, SSL certificate, and design age signals. Async batch support included.
